subject: The one mistake that ruins your Red Flag Scanner results
preview_text: I discovered why most users get this wrong. It's not what you think. And it's costing them everything.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. For months, I watched users get the same thing wrong. They'd scan one text, see a low toxicity score, and breathe a sigh of relief. They'd think they were safe. And then, weeks later, they'd be back in the same painful cycle, asking 'How did I miss this?'

The mistake? Scanning in isolation. Looking at one red flag and thinking it's the whole story. Toxicity isn't a single text. It's a pattern. It's the slow drip of manipulation across weeks. It's the love bombing that makes the gaslighting seem like a 'bad day.' Looking at one screenshot is like judging a movie by one frame. You miss the entire plot.

That's why the Pattern Detection feature exists. It's not just another button. It's the secret weapon. It connects the dots across ALL your conversations. It shows you the trajectory. A single 'you're too sensitive' might score a 3. But seeing it pop up 12 times over a month? That's a 47. That's the truth. That's what protects you.

Open the app right now. Go to your dashboard and look at 'Pattern Detection.' See the timeline. See the connections. Your gut has been collecting data points for months. Let the AI connect them. P.S. The 800+ users who avoided disaster? They all used this one feature first. Don't be the one who skips it.
